description.value: 88 Supermarket is a Canadian-owned authentic Asian supermarket on Victoria Drive in Vancouver. It stocks a broad range of Asian and western groceries including daily fresh meat cuts, live seafood, an extensive produce department with exotic and hard-to-find fruits and vegetables, dairy, and bakery items. The store runs a loyalty club card program and regular weekly specials, and has recently expanded with a new Richmond location.
